content.text:
**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- Corio is the customer/licensee here (it licenses and pays for Commerce One's BuySite software), so the rule tests amounts payable *by* Corio.
- No liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee mechanic exists: searches for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "interest" and "minimum" turn up nothing relevant, and Section 4 (Fees) plus Exhibit B Payment Terms impose only accrued license, maintenance, MarketSite access, implementation (capped) and revenue-share amounts.
- Section 11 allows termination for uncured material breach or insolvency with no pre-agreed damages sum; Section 11.3's surviving payment obligations are ordinary accrued fees for Customers Corio continues to serve.
- Items running in our favour — Exhibit C support commitments, Exhibit B revenue share to Corio, and refund remedies on non-acceptance, warranty breach and IP indemnity — are beneficial and were not flagged.

This satisfies the preferred position, so no redline was proposed.
